root_cause_verification.rationale: The root cause was that pretool-workflow-gate.py blocked mcp__happy__change_title during active workflows. The fix adds it to ALWAYS_ALLOWED set, which causes it to exit(0) before any workflow lock check. This is the correct approach because the tool is infrastructure, not a dev tool. Browser evidence confirms title changes now succeed and render as service messages.
